mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.department_id, u.employee_number, u.display_name, d.name AS department_name FROM users u INNER JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE u.cognito_sub = #{cognitoSub} AND u.active = TRUE AND d.active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET cognito_sub = #{cognitoSub}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
